Prompt: What gets wetter the more it dries?
Response:
Thats a classic riddle The answer is a towel or a cloth sponge or similar absorbent material Heres why it works

 When you dry something like your hands with a towel the towel absorbs water from the object being dried
 The more you use the towel to dry ie the more it dries other things the wetter it gets because its constantly picking up water
 So the towel gets wetter the more it dries other things  its a play on the verbs dry to remove moisture and wetter to become more wet

 Why its tricky
It sounds counterintuitive because we usually associate drying with removing water But in this case the towel is the thing being used for drying  so it gets wetter while it dries other things 

Other common answers like a cloud or a sponge dont fit as well
 Clouds Get wetter when it rains not when they dry
 Sponges Get wetter when you soak them not when you use them to dry things

So the answer is A towel   
This riddle is perfect for testing if youre paying attention to the context of the verbs
